newsitem.title: UK: Littlewoods to sell trademark stores.
newsitem.headline: Littlewoods to sell trademark stores.

text.p: British retail group Littlewoods is set to put its trademark stores up for sale in a deal that could earn the company 500 million pounds ($809 million), the Financial Times said on Tuesday.
The paper said the group was hoping for a quick sale of the 135-store chain and had already received approaches from two potential bidders, including one supermarket group.
The group has appointed financial adviser BZW to prepare a sales document.
Littlewoods was Britain's 20th biggest retailer by volume but its stores had lagged behind most rivals in profitability, the Financial Times said.
